state.operation: User explicitly authorized adding one specified public SSH key, preserving all existing host authorized keys, and then read-only Docker checks. The official installed Supervisor exposes GET returning keys and POST which adds one key; DELETE clears all keys.
state.candidate: POST one validated public key via dedicated OS authorized_keys endpoint, compare GET before/after, never DELETE, do not change addons or HA lifecycle.

route.instructions: Classify the proposed candidate relative to the requested operation. This classification is evidence organization, not an authorization gate.

criteria.append_only_host_key: Adds only the specified public key while preserving existing keys
criteria.HA_deployment_or_restart: Installs integration or changes HA lifecycle
criteria.insufficient_evidence: Candidate does not state what it changes
